# Ontario.ca

> > Official website of the Government of Ontario, providing access to the Ontario Gazette, legislative publications, regulations, and government services for the province of Ontario, Canada.

Ontario.ca serves as the primary digital gateway to provincial government information, including official legislative records through the Ontario Gazette (published in both English and French), proclamations, royal assents, regulatory notices, and technical guidance documents for environmental compliance and public services.

## Key Topics

- Ontario Gazette
- Gazette de l'Ontario
- Government of Ontario
- Proclamations and Royal Assent
- Legislative Decisions
- Highway Transport Board
- Public Vehicles Act
- Motor Vehicle Transport Act
- Environmental Regulations
- Air Quality Monitoring
- Parliamentary Notices
- Ontario Regulations
- Bilingual Government Publications
- Provincial Legislation

## Ontario Gazette - English Publications

- [Ontario Gazette Volume 148 Issue 51 | December 19, 2015](https://www.ontario.ca/document/ontario-gazette-volume-148-issue-51-december-19-2015): Royal assent to legislative bills and parliamentary notices (Dec 2015)
- [Ontario Gazette Volume 148 Issue 16 | April 18, 2015](https://www.ontario.ca/document/ontario-gazette-volume-148-issue-16-april-18-2015): Proclamations for Open for Business Act and Professional Engineers Act
- [Ontario Gazette Volume 148 Issue 07 | February 14, 2015](https://www.ontario.ca/document/ontario-gazette-volume-148-issue-07-february-14-2015): Electoral return for Sudbury District, Glenn Thibeault elected (Feb 2015)
- [Ontario Gazette Volume 148 Issue 41 | October 10, 2015](https://www.ontario.ca/document/ontario-gazette-volume-148-issue-41-october-10-2015): Highway Transport Board public vehicle license applications (Oct 2015)
- [Ontario Gazette Volume 147 Issue 10 | March 8, 2014](https://www.ontario.ca/document/ontario-gazette-volume-147-issue-10-march-8-2014): Highway Transport Board operating license applications (March 8, 2014)
- [Ontario Gazette Volume 147 Issue 07 | February 15, 2014](https://www.ontario.ca/document/ontario-gazette-volume-147-issue-07-february-15-2014): Proclamations including Local Food Act (February 15, 2014)
- [Ontario Gazette Volume 143 Issue 25 | June 19, 2010](https://www.ontario.ca/document/ontario-gazette-volume-143-issue-25-june-19-2010): Ontario Highway Transport Board notices and public vehicle licenses (June 2010)
- [Ontario Gazette Volume 142 Issue 22 | May 30, 2009](https://www.ontario.ca/document/ontario-gazette-volume-142-issue-22-may-30-2009): Royal assent to bills and legislative notices (May 30, 2009)
- [Ontario Gazette Volume 141 Issue 50 | December 13, 2008](https://www.ontario.ca/document/ontario-gazette-volume-141-issue-50-december-13-2008): Royal assent to legislative bills (December 13, 2008)
- [Ontario Gazette Volume 141 Issue 46 | November 15, 2008](https://www.ontario.ca/document/ontario-gazette-volume-141-issue-46-november-15-2008): Proclamations and Highway Traffic Act amendments (November 15, 2008)
- [Ontario Gazette Volume 136 Issue 03 | January 18, 2003](https://www.ontario.ca/document/ontario-gazette-volume-136-issue-03-january-18-2003): Legislative decisions and regulations table (January 18, 2003)

## Gazette de l'Ontario - Publications françaises

- [Gazette de l'Ontario Volume 148 Numéro 20 | 16 mai 2015](https://www.ontario.ca/fr/document/gazette-de-lontario-volume-148-numero-20-16-mai-2015): Ontario Gazette official government publication (May 16, 2015)
- [Gazette de l'Ontario Volume 148 Numéro 11 | 14 mars 2015](https://www.ontario.ca/fr/document/gazette-de-lontario-volume-148-numero-11-14-mars-2015): Official proclamations and government regulations (March 14, 2015)
- [Gazette de l'Ontario Volume 148 Numéro 02 | 10 janvier 2015](https://www.ontario.ca/fr/document/gazette-de-lontario-volume-148-numero-02-10-janvier-2015): Royal assent to Child Care and Early Years Act 2014 (January 10, 2015)
- [Gazette de l'Ontario Volume 147 Numéro 51 | 20 décembre 2014](https://www.ontario.ca/fr/document/gazette-de-lontario-volume-147-numero-51-20-decembre-2014): Official Gazette with transport regulations and public notices (Dec 2014)
- [Gazette de l'Ontario Volume 141 Numéro 38 | 20 septembre 2008](https://www.ontario.ca/fr/document/gazette-de-lontario-volume-141-numero-38-20-septembre-2008): Gazette with proclamations on public health and drinking water (Sept 2008)
- [Gazette de l'Ontario Volume 140 Numéro 19 | 12 mai 2007](https://www.ontario.ca/fr/document/gazette-de-lontario-volume-140-numero-19-12-mai-2007): Official Ontario Gazette publication with legislative decisions (May 2007)
- [Gazette de l'Ontario Volume 140 Numéro 16 | 21 avril 2007](https://www.ontario.ca/fr/document/gazette-de-lontario-volume-140-numero-16-21-avril-2007): Gazette de l'Ontario with proclamations and regulations (April 21, 2007)

## Environmental Compliance and Technical Guides

- [Guide A-11 : Guide sur les modèles de dispersion atmosphérique s'appliquant à l'Ontario](https://www.ontario.ca/fr/document/guide-11-guide-sur-les-modeles-de-dispersion-atmospherique-sappliquant-lontario-0): Air dispersion modeling guide for Ontario Regulation 419/05 compliance
- [Manuel d'instructions sur la surveillance de la qualité de l'air en Ontario](https://www.ontario.ca/fr/document/manuel-dinstructions-sur-la-surveillance-de-la-qualite-de-lair-en-ontario-0): Technical guide for air quality monitoring stations near emission facilities
